data.content_ref: inline:No causal mechanism is proposed for WHY first-order observability should favor panels or WHY second-order synthesis should favor experts; the target merely redescribes a statistical regularity (panel-vs-expert performance across task-types) as an abstraction without supplying any dependence, reduction, or shared-mechanism account. Under school-0's demand for a causal mechanism, naming a classificatory boundary ('first-order vs second-order') and labeling it an 'abstraction' is a summary of endpoints, not a substantive relation explaining how the order-property causally modulates panel/expert reliability.
